Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
IF :SYSTEM.record_status != 'QUERY' THEN
declare
 temp_product_code VARCHAR2(8);
 temp_bag_id VARCHAR2(4);
-- temp_bag_id char(4);
 temp_rec_no VARCHAR2(3);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select code_desc, eff_date, term_date
 into :bag_description, :bag_eff_date, :bag_term_date
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'BAGID' and
 code = :bag_id and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('1125');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 temp_product_code := :product_code;
 temp_bag_id := :bag_id;
 temp_rec_no := :system.trigger_record;

 go_record('1');

 while :system.last_record = 'FALSE'
 loop
 if :product_code = temp_product_code and
 :bag_id = temp_bag_id and
 :system.trigger_record != temp_rec_no
 then
 go_record(temp_rec_no);
 show_error('0069');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 down;
 end loop;
 if :product_code = temp_product_code and
 :bag_id = temp_bag_id and
 :system.trigger_record != temp_rec_no
 then
 go_record(temp_rec_no);
 show_error('0069');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 go_record(temp_rec_no);
 GO_ITEM('bag_id');
end;
END IF;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 chp_sysdate DATE;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 IF :system.record_status in ('NEW','INSERT','CHANGED')
 THEN
 IF is_timezone_enabled THEN
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,chp_sysdate);
 ELSE
 chp_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 END IF;

 if trunc(:eff_date) < trunc(chp_sysdate)--IM:8722
 then
 show_error('8044');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 END IF;
 if :term_date is not null and
 trunc(:eff_date) > trunc(:term_date)
 then
 next_item;
 show_error('8045');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if trunc(:eff_date) < trunc(:product_eff_date)
 then
 show_error('8049');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if trunc(:eff_date) < trunc(:bag_eff_date)
 then
 show_error('8051');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 chp_sysdate DATE;
begin
 if :term_date is null
 then
 if trunc(:product_term_date) < trunc(:bag_term_date)
 then
 if :product_term_date is not null then -- IM:8722; Without this if condition, system.record_status is modified to 'CHANGED' which will trigger validations for eff_date field.
 :term_date := :product_term_date;
 end if;
 else
 if :bag_term_date is not null then -- IM:8722; Without this if condition, system.record_status is modified to 'CHANGED' which will trigger validations for eff_date field.
 :term_date := :bag_term_date;
 end if;
 end if; 
 end if;
 if trunc(:term_date) < trunc(:eff_date)
 then
 show_error('8045');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 -- IM:8722
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 lifetrack_timezone_Convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 if :product_bag.term_date is not null then -- Added by Kishore on 07/08/2013. IM 9418
 -- Added by Kishore on 07/08/2013. IM 9418
 if trunc(:product_bag.term_date) < trunc(chp_sysdate) then
 show_error('3115');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 -- End of change
 
 if :product_bag.product_term_date is not null then -- Added by Kishore on 07/08/2013. IM 9418
 if nvl(:term_date,chp_sysdate) > nvl(:product_term_date,chp_sysdate) then -- IM:8722
 show_error('8053');
 check_package_failure;
 end if; -- Added by Kishore on 07/08/2013. IM 9418
 end if;
 
 if :product_bag.bag_term_date is not null then -- Added by Kishore on 07/08/2013. IM 9418
 if nvl(:term_date,chp_sysdate) > nvl(:bag_term_date,chp_sysdate) then -- IM:8722
 show_error('8054');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if; -- Added by Kishore on 07/08/2013. IM 9418
 end if; -- Added by Kishore on 07/08/2013. IM 9418
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :system.form_status = 'QUERY'
 then
 show_error('8013');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 execute_trigger('validate_record');
 check_package_failure;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 savepoint all_clear;
 check_pass;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if not form_success
 then
 rollback to savepoint all_clear;
 clear_record;
 handle_error;
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;
